metas.name: Carrie
metas.description: A sheltered girl with telekinetic powers is bullied, leading to a horrific, bloody incident due to her domineering mother's influence.

metas.name: Below
metas.description: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a remote town, a fisherman must fight to protect his family, his community, and his way of life.

metas.name: East of Eden
metas.description: In the farmlands of the Salinas Valley in California, successive generations of two families, the Trasks and the Hamiltons, are destined to reenact the fateful story of Cain and Abel.

metas.name: Lanterns
metas.description: Lanterns follows new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, two intergalactic cops drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

metas.name: MobLand
metas.description: Power is up for grabs as two warring crime families clash in a battle that threatens to topple empires. In the crossfire stands Harry Da Souza, a street-smart 'fixer' who knows too well where loyalties lie when opposing forces col...

metas.name: Avatar: Seven Havens
metas.description: After a world-shattering disaster, a young Earthbender learns she's the post-Korra Avatar. Now seen as a harbinger of doom, she and her twin race to save the Seven Havens while pursued by humans and spirits alike.

metas.name: Neagley
metas.description: Neagley, drawing from her experience with Jack Reacher and the 110 Special Investigators, embarks on a perilous mission to expose a sinister threat, risking her life to unravel the mystery.

metas.name: Widow's Bay
metas.description: A skeptical mayor leads the superstitious residents of a cursed New England island.

metas.name: Coven Academy
metas.description: Teen witch apprentices band together to defend New Orleans against an approaching dark force.

metas.name: Last Seen
metas.description: Police dispatcher Ian Ridley's daughter Maggie disappeared years ago. He receives a call, believing it's her, and embarks on a relentless quest to find her and reunite his family, disregarding consequences.

metas.name: Brothers
metas.description: McConaughey and Harrelson they try to live together on a Texas ranch. That close space puts their friendship to the test.

metas.name: Kill Jackie
metas.description: Ex-cocaine dealer Jackie Price lives luxuriously selling art through tax schemes. After 20 years of anonymity, her peaceful life ends when The Seven Demons, elite hitmen, are hired to kill her.

metas.name: Dexter: Resurrection
metas.description: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. But when Miami Metro's Angel Batista arrives with questions, Dexter realizes his past is catching up to him fast.

metas.name: Haunted Hotel
metas.description: A single mom with two kids operates a haunted hotel, aided by her late brother's ghost who believes they can have ingenious ideas despite his ethereal state.

metas.name: The Pitt
metas.description: The daily lives of healthcare professionals in a Pittsburgh hospital as they juggle personal crises, workplace politics, and the emotional toll of treating critically ill patients, revealing the resilience required in their noble ...

metas.name: Marshals
metas.description: Ex-Navy SEAL Kayce Dutton leaves the Yellowstone ranch to work with an elite U.S. Marshals team.

metas.name: A Different World
metas.description: Deborah Wayne enters her freshman year at Hillman College, her parents' HBCU alma mater, where she must escape their shadow and build her own legacy.

metas.name: Furious
metas.description: A determined FBI agent delves into a female killer's history while partnering with a seasoned investigator to track her down.

metas.name: Best Medicine
metas.description: A brilliant surgeon leaves Boston to become a doctor in the small town where he spent childhood summers. Despite his medical skills, his rude manner alienates locals as he battles hidden phobias and struggles with personal connect...

metas.name: Line of Fire
metas.description: A family of law enforcement agents become targets of a mysterious assassin after a U.S. Marshal falls in the line of duty, forcing them to use their expertise to protect each other.

metas.name: Small Prophets
metas.description: Eccentric Michael Sleep, whose darling partner, Clea, disappeared seven years ago, sets out to create Homunculi - magical prophesying spirits that can predict the future.

metas.name: Youth
metas.description: A 50-year-old divorcee juggles dating life while taking care of her parents and adult son.

metas.name: Sheriff Country
metas.description: Mickey Fox investigates criminal activity and patrols the streets of small-town Edgewater while contending with her ex-con father and a mysterious incident involving her wayward daughter.

metas.name: Winter
metas.description: Dr Ethan Winter, an analytical detective, partners with driven DI Lauren Bell. His deductive genius aids her murder squad, but he's haunted by an unsolved murder of someone close to him.

metas.name: Anna Pigeon
metas.description: Park ranger Anna Pigeon left city life after personal tragedy. Now she channels her pain into investigating crimes in national parks, determined to solve cases despite any obstacles.

metas.name: The Celebrity Traitors UK
metas.description: A psychological game show that follows celebrities where the contestants are trying to outwit, outplay, and outlast the challenge.

metas.name: Marble Hall Murders
metas.description: Follows Susan's return to England where she investigates a mystery involving a children's author's death, connected to a 1955 story set in Corfu.

metas.name: Scrubs
metas.description: JD and Turk scrub in together after a long break. Medicine and interns have evolved, but their friendship remains strong. New and familiar faces at Sacred Heart bring laughs, emotion, and unexpected moments.

metas.name: The Blame
metas.description: Two detectives fall in love while investigating a murder, until one becomes a suspect.

metas.name: Doc
metas.description: Dr. Amy Larsen loses her memory during a car accident. She must return to being an intern and somehow rebuild her life from the pieces that remain.

metas.name: Off Campus
metas.description: A college-set romantic drama chronicling the unexpected love story between a music student and the university's star hockey player, exploring themes of love and the complexities of adulthood through deep friendships and enduring b...

metas.name: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
metas.description: A century before the events of "Game of Thrones," Ser Duncan the Tall, and his squire, Egg, wander through Westeros while the Targaryen dynasty rule the Iron Throne. Great destinies and enemies await the incomparable friends.

metas.name: American Hostage
metas.description: Fred Heckman, a beloved Indianapolis radio reporter, is thrust into the middle of a life-or-death crisis when hostage-taker, Tony Kiritsis, demands to be interviewed on his popular radio news program.

metas.name: R.J. Decker
metas.description: Ex-con photographer RJ Decker becomes a PI in South Florida, solving strange cases with help from his journalist ex, her cop wife, and an enigmatic woman from his past who may help or destroy him.

metas.name: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
metas.description: Comic book store owner Stuart Bloom, from The Big Bang Theory (2007), returns in a new series where he attempts—and apparently fails—to save the universe, staying true to his unlucky nature.

metas.name: Sterling Point
metas.description: Annie and her twin brother, raised in NYC by their single father, discover their estranged grandfather bequeathed them a lake island.

metas.name: Paradise
metas.description: A Secret Service agent investigates the murder of a former president in a seemingly peaceful community.

metas.name: The Beast in Me
metas.description: Author Aggie Wiggs, grieving the loss of her son, finds new purpose unraveling the mystery behind neighbor Nile Jarvis' vanished wife and his suspicious dealings.

metas.name: I Will Find You
metas.description: A father imprisoned for his son's murder receives evidence suggesting his child may be alive, compelling him to escape and uncover the truth.

metas.name: The Final Problem
metas.description: In 1959, 13 people are stranded on an islet near Mallorca during a storm. At their small hotel, English tourist Elisa Mander is found dead. When suicide seems unlikely, retired actor Basil, once Sherlock Holmes on screen, investig...

metas.name: Adults
metas.description: A twenty-something ensemble comedy centering on codependent housemates navigating adulthood together despite their flaws.

metas.name: The Pendragon Cycle: Rise of the Merlin
metas.description: Showcases a retelling of the Arthurian legend set in a Roman-occupied Britain where barbarian invaders threaten to lay claim to the island.

metas.name: The Perfect Lie
metas.description: Four couples in a tight-knit group enjoy an extravagant lifestyle. When one of their villas burns down and a member dies, their web of lies begins to unravel.

metas.name: CIA

metas.name: Outlander: Blood of My Blood

metas.name: Dutton Ranch
metas.description: Beth Dutton and Rip Wheeler fight to survive on their cherished 7,000-acre ranch amid tough times and stiff competition, while ensuring young Carter becomes the man he's supposed to be.

metas.name: The Shards
metas.description: The Shards is part teenage coming of age, erotic thriller and exploration of the untamed and mysterious era of Los Angeles 1981, tracking a group of privileged high school friends as a serial killer strikes across the city.

metas.name: Your Friends & Neighbors
metas.description: A hedge fund manager resorts to burglary after losing his job, targeting wealthy neighbors to maintain his family's lifestyle, but makes a fateful error breaking into the wrong home.

metas.name: Lucky
metas.description: A reformed criminal is forced to confront her past and return to illicit activities for one final job, hoping to secure her freedom and leave her former life behind for good.
